verdict.rationale: Adyen exposes a Terminal API for payments, refunds, tipping, and a Management API for terminal ordering/config, plus a Disputes API and even an MCP server for natural-language API access, indicating broad API parity with UI features. However, some functions (terminal management, refunds) are explicitly also routed through the Customer Area UI, and a community account describes painful, incomplete card-present API integration ('made us integrate with COM... ditched Adyen'), showing real-world friction not reflected in the docs claims.
